text:
Anya (Growth): Kicking off a small pilot: 'Prompt Mosaic' + micro-credits to drive first-10-requests activation. Hypothesis: tailored prompt templates + small credit nudge -> +10% activation within 7 days. Thoughts?

Michael H: Love it. Which segments are we targeting? demo signups, webinar RSVPs, or organic signups?

Anya (Growth): Start with webinar RSVPs + demo signups (they convert higher). 500 users total split 60/40. Can we route them differently? :thinking_face:

Samir: I can wire inbound routing. Plan: tag cohorts as `mosaic_webinar` and `mosaic_demo`. Send credits only to users with zero or <3 requests. TTL 7 days, amount 50 starter-tokens.

Jess: Prompt side — propose 5 archetypes: 
- code helper
- brainstorm (marketing hooks)
- rewrite (concise/long-form)
- summarizer (docs -> TL;DR)
- product-idea (seed).
I'll draft 2 variants each (A/B).

Maya: Need baseline metrics. @data-bot can you pull last 30d activation heatmap for webinar vs demo cohorts and avg requests at day 7?


data-bot: Pull queued for `activation_heatmap_v2`. ETA ~45m. Link: https://internal.data/reports/activation_heatmap_v2 (private).

Michael H: For measurement — primary metric: pct users with >=2 meaningful requests by day 7. Secondary: avg tokens/use, retention at day 14. Use uplift vs synthetic control (previous 2 weeks).

Anya (Growth): Messaging cadence: Day 0 credit email + in-app nudge, Day 2 template surfacing in console, Day 5 reminder with tips. Keep copy short and product-focused.

Jess: Draft copy snippet for email (A):
```
Subject: Your 50 Starter Tokens — Try these prompts
Hi {{first_name}}, here are 5 quick prompts to get value fast. Use them in the console — tokens expire in 7 days.
[CTA: Try prompts]
```
Will share variants in figma.

Samir: Routing checklist: 
- flag inbound events -> cohort tag
- push to experiments queue `mosaic_v1`
- ensure no overlap with existing credit campaigns
I'll post the config in #eng-infra when ready.

Maya: Agree on exclusion: exclude current paid customers and anyone who got credits in last 30 days. Also exclude high-volume trial users (to avoid spend).

Anya (Growth): Budget: 500 users * 50 tokens = 25k starter-tokens. ROI checkpoint after 7 days; flip to broader if >=10% activation lift.

Michael H: Add one qualitative check — 20 users get short follow-up survey in-app after day 3 for friction signals.

Jess: I'll attach prompt examples and mockups by EOD.

Samir: Routing config (draft):
```
{
  "experiment": "mosaic_v1",
  "cohorts": ["mosaic_webinar", "mosaic_demo"],
  "credit_amount": 50,
  "ttl_days": 7,
  "exclusions": ["paid_customer", "recent_credit_30d", "high_volume_trial"]
}
```
Posting to #eng-infra now.

Anya (Growth): Great. Owners: Anya (strategy), Jess (prompts & copy), Samir (routing), Maya (analysis). Check-in Friday 11am PT. :rocket:

Michael H: +1. Thanks team!

data-bot: activation_heatmap_v2 ready: snapshot saved, link above.

Anya (Growth): If anyone sees overlap with other campaigns ping me. Otherwise we roll Monday.

Jess: Noted — will include language variant for international users.

Samir: Config posted: https://internal.deploy/experiments/mosaic_v1 (ops-only).

Maya: I'll prep the analysis dashboard and set alerts for regression.

Anya (Growth): Perfect. Closing thread — see Friday sync. :thumbsup:
